score_notes.A: No body H1, two-level categories, use_math true with $$ at L235-239 and L511. Deductions: the description is 114 characters (L5; the blog needs 120-160). The install command appears twice (L74 and L571). The Sources list leaks HTML entities ('|' at L1239, '[Serve]' at L1240). 'W2 페이지' (L1200, L1216) is an internal source id shown to readers. The Anyscale blog cited at L243/L251 is missing from Sources.
score_notes.B: The 입니다 register holds throughout, with no colon lists after 다. Deductions: L63 '기본 단위는 셋입니다' then defines only deployment and application; rewrite as '기본 단위는 디플로이먼트, 레플리카, 애플리케이션 셋입니다'. L122 says it is an example twice in one paragraph ('설명을 위해 지어낸 예시입니다 ... (이해를 돕기 위한 예시입니다)') and uses the formulaic '정리하면 다음과 같습니다'. L740 '표로 정리하면 이렇습니다' is formulaic. L1154 is meta commentary about the docs ('설명문에는 ... 나오지만, 예제 코드가 실제로 쓰는 키는'). L21 and L13 are overloaded single sentences.
score_notes.C: Mostly one arc around text_ml:app. Deductions: L214-217 defines a second 'class Translator: ...' with '본문은 다음 절에서 채웁니다', but no later section merges the router config into the running Translator. L509 tells readers to change a serve_config.yaml that is only produced later (L933-961). The 'built' YAML at L941-961 shows Translator num_replicas: 1, while the post's own decorator (L85) has num_replicas=2. serve build on the post's code emits num_replicas: 2 plus ray_actor_options, and names the app app1.
score_notes.D: Help lands where it is hard: the bind/runtime/remote timeline table (L298-302), the backoff table (L226-233), the prefix-tree worked example (L247), the response-type table (L459-463), the histogram bucket example on the running app (L1180) and the proxy state diagram (L1103-1107). Some padding: the L842 examples catalogue and the L33 feature list.
score_notes.E: Tables and code sit where they are discussed, and the cells hold noun phrases. The ASCII stack (L39-55) and the request-path diagram (L169-184) help. The Ray-paper figure (L138) has Korean alt text. Small redundancy: the backoff table and the formula (L226-239) carry the same three defaults. The official Serve architecture figure is not used.
score_notes.F: 3 of 15 sampled claims are unsupported. (1) L144 says the policy evaluation time is 5ms or 10ms 'depending on input size'. The paper uses two different models: a residual net (10ms) on 4KB states and a small FC net (5ms) on 100KB states. (2) L1121 credits the Serve config-file doc with a status list (NOT_STARTED…DELETING; HEALTHY/UNHEALTHY/UPDATING). The fetched config page (latest and releases-2.59.0) has no status list. DELETING appears only in the monitoring doc's metrics enum. (3) L1212 credits Suhas Bhairav with KServe judgements. The listed Suhas page never mentions KServe. Outside the sample: L509 says serve deploy rejects num_replicas: 1 next to a code-level autoscaling_config. That is wrong: on a private Ray 2.60.0 cluster, deploy_apps accepted it, the app ran (RUNNING, Translator HEALTHY) and autoscaling_config was kept. L550 calls RFC #63144 '제안 단계, 미구현', but the issue was closed as completed on 2026-09-23. L1192 credits Suhas with Train/Tune/Data integration claims that page does not make, and labels W2 '날짜 표기 없음' though the matching Suhas page says 'Published June 11, 2026'.
